patterns.title: What nobody tells you about [place]
patterns.detail: The two biggest outliers in the whole sample, 702x and 221x, both in Spanish. Aim it at a place, not at a process.

patterns.title: Local "why" that is not about houses

patterns.title: Walk up to it and point
patterns.detail: Inspectors showing the defect in the first frame: 32x and 25x, up to 2.3M views. The payoff is visual.

patterns.title: A favourites list that invites correction
patterns.detail: "My 3 favorite restaurants. What did I miss?" did 42x on a 788-subscriber account.

patterns.title: Skip: generic advice, famous houses, national economy
patterns.detail: "Stop doing X" openers under-perform, and the big trivia and economy numbers come from people who will never buy in Baltimore.
